name: same-employer-opportunity-cluster-prioritizer
purpose: Reduce duplicate application effort when one employer has multiple simultaneous eligible vacancies, without changing eligibility, stable IDs, CRM state or canonical dedupe.

hardPreconditions.remoteRule: remote-ok requires explicit evidence that work can be performed primarily from Slovakia without regular distant commuting

employerIdentity.rule: cluster only when canonical employer identity is high-confidence; staffing agency and end-client remain distinct unless explicitly proven identical

prioritization.lowerRankedAction: retain-live-or-verification-state; suppress duplicate application urgency only
